title: DiscordSquared
description: A very configurable Discord <-> Minecraft bridge mod
body:
# DiscordSquared

![very high-quality logo](https://github.com/rozbrajaczpoziomow/DiscordSquared/blob/main/src/main/resources/assets/discordsquared/textures/logo.png?raw=true)

DiscordSquared is a server-only mod for Discord <-> Minecraft communication. It uses a webhook for Minecraft -> Discord communication and a discord bot for Discord -> Minecraft communication (uses Kord under the hood).

It's also highly configurable and has formattable rich presence, player join/leave/chat/death, server start/stop messages and discord commands.

![test screenshot](https://github.com/rozbrajaczpoziomow/DiscordSquared/blob/main/assets/test-screenshot-edited.png?raw=true)

## Dependencies

![badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/required-Forgelin--Continuous-gray?style=flat-square&labelColor=red&link=https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/forgelin-continuous)  
DiscordSquared is written in Kotlin, and as such requires Forgelin Continuous to be present.
